services.name: Nigerian standard passport renewal
services.location_scope: Lagos, Nigeria; applicant selects a processing centre in the official application portal
eligibility: Renewal or reissue of a standard passport for an applicant applying within Nigeria

required_documents.label: NPC birth certificate or declaration of age from a High Court
Current passport booklet for in-person biometric capture

preparation_steps.label: Verify NIN and ensure personal details match the NIMC record
Complete the renewal application online and select a processing centre and booklet size
Pay through the application process and book a biometric enrolment appointment
Attend the selected immigration office for biometric data capture

services.fee_note: NIS announced these domestic standard-passport application fees effective 2025-09-01. Confirm the final amount in the official application before payment.

services.name: National driver's licence renewal
services.location_scope: Lagos, Nigeria; applicant selects a processing centre in the FRSC application portal
eligibility: FRSC renewal page: holder of a valid licence may renew within 30 days before expiry
For a user with an existing but recently expired licence, the FRSC FAQ directs them to start renewal, not a new application.

preparation_steps.label: Pay the licence fee and confirm payment at the Board or Internal Revenue office
Proceed to VIO for the required test
Visit an FRSC Driver's Licence Centre for biometric capture

services.fee_note: Renewal fee not confirmed in the checked official sources. The reviewed FRSC FAQ lists prices for a new licence, not renewal.
